notablePrerequisites:
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other Shrines.
description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability.
Resolve the copy of Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
